semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical exhaust gas treatment solutions for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: CS CLEAN SOLUTIONS GmbH is a leading provider of exhaust gas treatment systems for the semiconductor industry. Their proprietary CLEANSORB® technology offers environmentally friendly abatement of hazardous gases without the use of fossil fuels or water, ensuring safety and reliability in semiconductor fabrication.

regional_presence.Europe: CS CLEAN SOLUTIONS operates a network of service centers across Europe, providing comprehensive support.
regional_presence.Americas: The company has a service network in the Americas to support its global operations.
regional_presence.Asia: CS CLEAN SOLUTIONS maintains a service presence in Asia to cater to the semiconductor industry's needs.
